features.name: Dashboard
features.expect: The business on one page: active school tenants, who is still onboarding, monthly recurring revenue and whether every school is actually being used — with the provisioning log underneath and one place to broadcast a maintenance notice to all of them at once.

features.name: Schools
features.expect: Every school on this installation with its plan, student headcount, status and the date it joined. Search by name, open one to act inside it for support.

features.name: Add School
features.expect: Create a school, its first campus and its first administrator in one step, and hand over the credentials.

features.name: Access
features.expect: Who may sign in and who may not: suspend a school for non-payment or at the end of a contract — blocking sign-in while keeping every record — and let them back in on settlement. The suspension takes effect on the next request, not the next restart.

features.name: Setup
features.expect: How far each new school has got through setup, and which step it is stuck on, so an account manager can intervene before a stalled rollout becomes a cancellation.

features.name: Plans & Pricing

features.name: Subscription Ledger
features.expect: Each school's plan, term dates, renewal date and invoice history.

features.name: License & Capacity
features.expect: Schools past the students their plan allows, and those inside the renewal window, with the revenue at risk against each. Counted from the live headcount, so a school that admitted forty children this morning shows forty seats used.

features.name: Module Entitlement Matrix
features.expect: Which modules each plan and each school may use; switching one off hides it from that school's navigation.

features.name: Adoption Metrics
features.expect: Sign-ins, active users and transactions per school per week — the leading indicator of renewal.

features.name: Instance Health
features.expect: Error rates, queue depth and slow endpoints per tenant, so the vendor sees a problem before the school reports it.

features.name: Usage & Cost
features.expect: What each school actually uses — files stored, records held, messages sent — against what the installation costs to run. Enter the monthly bill once and every school's share is read against what it pays, so a customer's price can be seen next to its cost.

features.name: Support
features.expect: Tickets raised by schools, with the tenant, severity, owner and time open.

features.name: Audit

features.name: System health

features.name: Dashboard

features.name: Substitutions

features.name: School Calendar

features.name: Curriculum Roadmap

features.name: Lesson Plans

features.name: Syllabus Progress

features.name: Class Setup

features.name: Performance overview
